headline.text: L1 Sollich 2 soft caramel issue still live at shift handoff — *3 hours down* overnight for enrober belt repair, now back but caramel quality unresolved.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 ran caramel cluster all window with two major stops: enrober wire mesh repair (3 hours down, cleared by third shift) and slitter congestion (10 minutes, cleared). Soft caramel at the conbar remains unresolved as of 07:14. Sollich 3 cleared a z-conveyor buildup but the belt is splitting and needs replacement soon.
per_plant_summary.L2: FFS had two lot-mixing incidents (both cleared same-shift) and a brief box printer fault (cleared). Lower hopper vibrator fuse replaced. ML2 swapped 68 dirty molds, completed Feastables China printer setup after multiple spacing adjustments, and started bulk-100 run at 02:40. ML3 cleared a dancing-arm bolt failure and a demolder belt tension issue; B19 sensor fault at 06:14 not yet resolved.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 Imperial fought dirty mold alarms all shift — chocolate buildup under hopper identified and being cleaned, but alarms continued through 07:13. C6 belt roller fixed. MFM cleared checkweigher and inlet sensor issues; staging ran dry at shift change but restarted. ML4 hit three mold jams; third jam at 06:56 still in progress at window close. Truffle Line cleared scraper and guillotine faults but is running tunnel 3 with four missing rollers (no parts on-site).

resolved.title: Enrober wire mesh broken, metal contamination risk
resolved.summary: Wire mesh on enrober belt broke; ran with 30-minute visual and MD/X-ray checks until third shift replaced belt section during lunch rotation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:57 — "Maintenance finished the repair on the belt. We are getting into temper" (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: Cavanna 4 temperature fault stopping machine
resolved.summary: Temperature sensor on Cavanna 4 caused repeated stops; maintenance presence appeared to clear it, continuing to monitor.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 00:12 — "It seems my presence corrected the issue. I'll keep an eye on it" (Caleb York).

resolved.title: Z-conveyor stuttering on excessive buildup
resolved.summary: Bottom roller on z-conveyor accumulated product causing stuttering; line paused for CILT cleanup.

resolved.title: Slitter congested with caramel, line down
resolved.summary: Caramel buildup on slitter and conbar required a cleaning pause; team cleared and restarted inside 10 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:37 — "Line start back again" (Francisco Gudino Torres).

resolved.title: Mixed lots 62CUC / 62KUC on Z conveyor and scales
resolved.summary: Two lots mixed at Z conveyor; line stopped, product inspected and separated, scales emptied, and line cleared before restarting.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 23:51 — "Line is running!" after full line clearance and fresh lot loaded (Zack Kurtz).

resolved.title: ML3 demolder belt no tension, line down
resolved.summary: Belt at demolder lost tension; maintenance adjusted and cleared inside 5 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:39 — "Line is back up" (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: Dirty molds causing stained bars on ML2
resolved.summary: Appearance degraded due to dirty 60g Feastables molds; swapped 68 dirty molds for clean ones from tote on floor.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:43 — "Reemplazamos 68 moldes sucios por limpios para mejorar la apariencia del chocolate" (ML2 Depositor).

resolved.title: ML2 demolding belt misaligned, line down
resolved.summary: Belt at demolding lost alignment; stopped for cleaning and belt correction.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:26 — "The line running again" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML3 dancing arm bolt broke, line down
resolved.summary: Bolt to dancing arm broke off in back; maintenance extracted broken bolt and replaced, line resumed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:11 — "Line running again" after bolt replaced (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: Box code printer malfunction
resolved.summary: Printer for box codes faulted; maintenance reset and line resumed within 45 minutes.

resolved.title: Lower hopper vibrator not functioning
resolved.summary: Vibrator on lower hopper set to max but barely moving, delaying product feed; maintenance replaced bad fuse.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:47 — "Vibrato is working, it was a bad fuse" (Fernando Flores).

resolved.title: Mixed lots 63 LUC / 63 JUC in single box
resolved.summary: One box with lot 63 LUC found on a 63 JUC pallet; team separated mixed product and resumed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:58 — "The parts mixed with different batches have already been separated" (Marlenis Fernandez).

resolved.title: Feastables China code date printer setup
resolved.summary: Code date lines inverted and spacing incorrect on new Feastables China run; required multiple adjustments and QA approval before starting.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 02:37 — "Looks great... Jose will monitor and if the code start to get off the line needs to stop" (Hervin Herrera), running at 02:40.

resolved.title: MFM checkweigher not detecting underweight pouches
resolved.summary: Checkweigher failed to reject low-weight pouches; caught immediately, no low pouches reached pallets, issue cleared.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 21:50 — "The issue was caught right away and no low pouches were placed on the pallet" (Angel Cabrera).

resolved.title: Truffle Line scraper to u belt broken
resolved.summary: Scraper component failed; maintenance repaired and line resumed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:21 — "The scraper has been fixed" (Raoul Lubain).

resolved.title: Truffle Line guillotine not functioning
resolved.summary: Guillotine rexroth faulted out; maintenance reset and confirmed running properly.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:35 — "Tha guillotine has been fixed. The rexroth had faulted out. They reset it" (Raoul Lubain).

resolved.title: C6 conveyor belt roller misaligned
resolved.summary: Roller used to align C6 belt moved out of position; third-shift mechanic fixed alignment, belt running correctly.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:45 — "He already fixed it, and the belt is now running correctly" (Grey Boscan).

resolved.title: MFM inlet sensor causing empty bags and accumulation
resolved.summary: Inlet sensor not gripping bags properly, resulting in many empty bags; maintenance adjusted sensor and repositioned C1.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:06 — "Had to make a minor adjustment to the infeed sensor and move C1 into the position I had it in yesterday" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: MFM out of WIP trays at shift change
resolved.summary: Third shift did not stage product pallets; line stopped at 07:00, warehouse brought pallet and line restarted.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:15 — "They've already brought in a pallet of product and we're filling the hopper to get started" (mfmatrix).

needs_attention.title: Soft caramel at Sollich 2 conbar, quality issue ongoing
needs_attention.summary: Caramel became very runny starting second shift; line stopped at 16:56, checks and adjustments made, but as of 07:14 still reporting soft caramel issues at the conbar.
needs_attention.status: Scrapers cleaned, conbar settings verified at original position, but Justin reports "We are still having issues with soft caramel at the conbar on S2" as of 07:14.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 z-conveyor belt splitting, needs replacement
needs_attention.summary: Belt is splitting at base of a flap, allowing pieces to fall inside with each rotation; requires ASAP replacement but maintenance does not have spare.
needs_attention.status: Caleb checking if new belt is available; rollers cleaned at 06:43 to keep running, but belt still splitting.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 second drum motor mount loose and bouncing
needs_attention.summary: Motor mount observed loose and bouncing; flagged by operator but no maintenance action recorded in window.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:07, no follow-up or repair mentioned.

needs_attention.title: Chains found in 62P lot chocolate on FFS
needs_attention.summary: Operator reported finding chains in the 62P lot chocolate being fed to FFS; QA notified and en route to inspect.
needs_attention.status: Jose Cabrera responded "I'm on my way" at 04:04; no update on findings or resolution.

needs_attention.title: ML3 sensor B19 malfunction, line stopped
needs_attention.summary: Flow-wrap line started at 06:03 then stopped immediately due to sensor B19 fault; no resolution recorded by window close.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 06:14, no follow-up on repair or restart.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line tunnel 3 missing four rollers, no parts on-site
needs_attention.summary: Roller to tunnel 3 broke; maintenance unable to fix, no replacement inventory, order placed with Jay, running without the rollers for now.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance confident line can run without them; Kavin placing order with Jay, but currently operating with four missing rollers on tunnel 3.

needs_attention.title: ML1 Imperial dirty mold alarms constant on both sides
needs_attention.summary: Persistent dirty mold alarms on north and south depositors; chocolate buildup under hopper identified and cleaning started, but alarms continued through 07:13.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance babysitting Imperial, chocolate buildup being cleaned per Grey at 06:51, but dirty mold alarms still occurring at 07:13.

needs_attention.title: ML4 mold jam, gondola being emptied
needs_attention.summary: Third mold jam of the shift; emptying gondola on cleaning mode with Chris and Nelson on-site as of 07:09.
needs_attention.status: Line stopped at 06:56, emptying gondola and cleaning as of 07:09, no restart confirmed.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line M4 belt running off track
needs_attention.summary: M4 belt misaligned and running off track; no resolution posted.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:01, no follow-up on adjustment or repair.

needs_attention.title: ML1 nozzle plate leaking chocolate, misadjusted
needs_attention.summary: Nozzle plate received leaking chocolate; operator noticed incorrect adjustment but no follow-up on correction.
needs_attention.status: Plate inspected at 06:59 and found not correctly adjusted; no update on fix.

needs_attention.title: ML1 camera fault, tunnel inspection underway
needs_attention.summary: Camera fault triggered; maintenance inspecting tunnel but no resolution posted.
